ev.quote: # SP I NQU A N T: LLM QUANTIZATION WITH LEARNED ROTATIONS
Equal contribution. Correspondence to: Zechun Liu <zechunliu@meta.com>.

contribution.value: SpinQuant proposes learned rotation matrices, optimized on the Stiefel manifold via Cayley SGD, that remove activation/weight outliers in LLMs and enable accurate W4A4KV4 post-training quantization.

ev.quote: we propose SpinQuant, a novel approach that incorporates learned rotation matrices for optimal quantized network accuracy. With 4-bit quantization of weight, activation, and KV-cache, SpinQuant narrows the accuracy gap on zero-shot reasoning tasks with full precision to merely 2.9 points on the LLaMA-2 7B model
we also report the perplexity score on WikiText2 testset (Merity et al., 2016) for our evaluation

strengths.value: SpinQuant_no_had merges learned rotations into weights, needing no kernel changes at inference time.

ev.quote: only needs to replace the original model weights with the rotated model weights, necessitating no modification to the forward pass nor any additional kernel support

strengths.value: Rotation training is fast: 13-30 minutes for small models and 3.5 hours for LLaMA-2 70B on a calibration set of 800 samples.

ev.quote: It takes only \sim 13 / 18 / 30 minutes for LLaMA-3 1B / 3B / 8B, respectively, and \sim 25 / 30 minutes for LLaMA-2 7B / 13B, respectively. For LLaMA-2 70B, it takes \sim 3.5 hours

strengths.value: Achieves a roughly 3x decoding speedup on MacBook M1 Pro CPU at W4A8 over FP16 LLaMA-3 8B.

ev.quote: The results in Table 6 demonstrate that 4-bit quantization yields a \sim 3\times speedup compared to the 16-bit model

weaknesses.value: Random rotations show up to 13-point variance in zero-shot accuracy, motivating the costly rotation learning step.

ev.quote: the performance variance is substantial, with the best random rotation matrix outperforming the worst by 13 points

weaknesses.value: SpinQuant_had adds online Hadamard rotations that introduce about 8% latency overhead at inference.

ev.quote: online Hadamard processing introduced a modest 8% increase in latency

weaknesses.value: Layer-level SQNR sometimes worsens for one layer after rotation learning, suggesting non-uniform layer-wise effects.

ev.quote: layer-level SNR improves significantly for a few layers, but does not change much for most layers, and even gets worse for one of the layers

limitations.value: The paper does not test below 3-bit weights, leaving 2-bit and ternary quantization unexplored.
